name: ky-tax-overview
description: Overview of Cayman Islands taxation for 2026. There is no income tax, no corporate tax, no capital gains tax, no VAT or sales tax, no payroll tax and no withholding tax. What exists is import duty (22% on most goods under the Customs Tariff Act 2026 Revision), stamp duty on land transfers (7.5%, and 10% from 1 January 2026 where the higher of price and market value is CI$2 million or more, with first-time and second-home reliefs for Caymanians), the same 7.5% and 10% tax on share transfers in land holding companies, the 13% tourist accommodation tax, mandatory private pensions and health insurance for employees, work permit and government registry fees, and economic substance reporting. Trigger on Cayman tax, is Cayman tax free, Cayman stamp duty, Cayman Islands taxes, moving to Cayman. Built from Cayman legislation; not reviewed by an accountant.
